fortress_treasure.name: Fortress Treasure
fortress_treasure.description: A fortified fortress with a secret vault where the treasure is kept safe from thieves and pirates.
fortress_treasure.image_prompt: ancient stone castle, dark and ominous

island_of_enigmas.name: Island of Enigmas
island_of_enigmas.description: The island Alden has been exploring. It's full of mysteries waiting to be solved.
island_of_enigmas.image_prompt: mysterious island at sea, foggy night

treasure_chest_locked.name: Treasure Chest (Locked)
treasure_chest_locked.description: The chest is sealed with a magical lock that only the bravest and most cunning can open.
treasure_chest_locked.image_prompt: locked treasure chest, glistening in sunlight

hero.name: Alden
hero.description: A brave young adventurer on his quest to find and protect the hidden treasure. He has a magical key from the shipwreck.

treasure_guard.name: Captain Blackbeard's Revenge
treasure_guard.description: The pirate who once hid this treasure now lives in seclusion in the fortress. He is not pleased to see Alden and won't let him pass.
treasure_guard.image_prompt: dangerous pirate captain with black beard, dark castle

dialogues.before_talk: Treasure Guard: You are not welcome here! This place belongs to me now...
dialogues.after_talk: Captain Blackbeard's Revenge: I will show you the error of your ways... but it won't be easy.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Captain Blackbeard's Revenge: Very well, you have shown courage. Now leave before I punish you!
dialogues.hostile: Captain Blackbeard's Revenge: How dare you enter this place? Guards! Stop the intruder!
